sloka: मम चेदं मतं तात धर्मो ऽयमिति राघव।धर्ममूलं त्वया छिन्नं राज्यमुत्सृजता तदा ।। ६.८३.३१ ।।
transliteration: mama cedaṁ mataṁ tāta dharmo 'yamiti rāghava।dharmamūlaṁ tvayā chinnaṁ rājyamutsṛjatā tadā ।। 6.83.31 ।।

translations.english: "Dear Raghava! In my opinion also depending on desire and context, following dharma or adharma is proper. You have severed the roots of dharma by giving up the kingdom."
